title: Chapter 704
paragraphs: Chapter 704
Episode 179. An Unavoidable Trap (3)
Suddenly, as Veradin waved his hand, a green window floated in the air.
The green window was too similar to the Record Magic.

The energy felt exactly the same as the one from the 'Sanctuary', the land where the remnants of the Sun God's energy remained, which Zipfel calls. Jin recognized that it was the price of saving Valeria in the sanctuary.
"…Record magic?"
"You’ve encountered the original often, won’t I be embarrassed if you look so surprised to see an imitation?"
However, it seemed that the elders who followed into the office were more surprised than Jin.
"Lord, you finally got that magic!?"
"Why didn't you tell us about this auspicious event?"
The elders were shining greedy eyes as if the tragedy the alliance was facing was of no concern.
Veradin kept smiling, and Jin, interpreting the darkness contained in that smile, intuitively realized what was going to happen next.
It was a purge.
"Why didn’t I tell you, elders? Because old and useless people don't need to know."
"What are you, huh!"
"Lord, choke, Lord, ugh, ugh…!"
The elders who tried to respond suddenly held their necks and twisted their bodies.
Suddenly, they couldn't breathe. Some sort of characters were being carved on Veradin's green window.
"But considering your efforts so far, I'm just showing you on the way. How is it? As I said, it didn’t take long, did it?"
Ronil was calmly standing as if he knew such a thing would happen, and Veradin looked down at the elders who fell foaming at the mouth.
Among them, one elder was gasping for breath, struggling against Veradin's magic.
He barely stood up with bloodshot eyes and reached out towards Veradin.
A deformed fireball sprang from that hand, but Veradin drew his sword and easily slashed it.
When the fireball dispersed, bloody tears flowed from the elder's eyes.
"Ah, I should have spared you..."
That was the last word the only elder who resisted the magic for a moment heard.
As he fell forward, there were no living elders left in the office.
Jin felt chills all over his body. It was not because of the magic that was close to the power shown by Veradin, or the hard-to-find flawed swordsmanship.
It was because he realized once again that his friend had changed. Friends and brothers alike. Everyone had become monsters.
"Originally, I was planning to handle this after you left, but this isn't bad either. Anyway, where were we? Ah, we were talking about confirming the size of despair. Take a look at this."
Veradin's green window expanded to fill the office.
The world map was drawn inside, filled with oozing black spots in all sorts of regions.
Huphester was particularly dark, almost impossible to find a transparent part, and the rest of the continents were full of lighter or similar stains.
"The black parts marked on this map are the despair being harvested by the abominable god. Roughly now, the abominable god is about 50% complete."
"What's the basis for that 50% estimate?"
"The speed at which the ship Ram is forming. Changes occur in Ram whenever a black spot increases. Orgal visited before you, and he equates the completion of Ram and the abominable god."
Veradin pointed to the spots in Drakka and the autonomous regions, as well as the Millkun Kingdom.

"These spots were formed simultaneously with the slaughter of Millkun Kingdom's commoners and the capture of hostages due to the federation's attack by Defense Runcandel. They are continuing to darken and grow. This is likely because the faith of the civilians, who thought at least the federation, especially Drakka where our headquarters is, would be safe, has been shattered."
As he said, the oozing spots were getting slightly bigger, but without rest.
Although it was certainly small compared to the entirety of Huphester, it was quite large compared to other places.
Jin, who had been quietly looking at the spots, turned his gaze to the Tikan Kingdom.
There was a black spot in Tikan too. Its size was literally a dot, but it was noticeably dark.
'Despair held by Sister Mary… or Yuria.'
Immediately, the two came to mind.
"I've heard about the relationship between the 7th and 4th flagbearers. Plus, Az Mil's contractor may be suffering after seeing some horrible future."
Veradin spoke, aware of Jin's gaze. Jin didn't respond and looked at other spots.
A spot in Huphester, and among them, there was one land that was changing the most actively.
Recalton.
The land where the former prophet used to gather human sacrifices.
Jin had asked the Black Knight Dox to investigate there in the past. Since then, Dox had been out of contact.

"It seems like you've noticed, watching Recalton so closely. We are sure that the 4th flagbearer is transferring all the hostages there. Because Recalton is the place where despair has been growing most actively since the federation was attacked."
Then the task was clear.
Attack Recalton and rescue the hostages.

Small-scale operations like before were not suitable. There was no way that all of the tens of thousands of hostages would be alive, but even if only a thousand were rescued due to the unfavorable situation, a fleet was definitely needed.

"Doesn't it feel absurd that humans are fighting gods? Without the element of despair, there would have been no reason for the world's greatest powers to step forward to save the common people in this situation."
"What do you mean?"

"What I mean is that it would be horribly inefficient if the opponents were human. What if you, an immunity to chaos, get hurt while trying to save ten thousand civilians? What if irreparable losses befall other top-tier forces? That's something that shouldn't happen."
Jin felt like he was hearing words from Rosa during her human years, not Veradin.
Ordinary people seemed to be just meaningless existences in Veradin's world now.

"Let's not indulge in pointless talk. It's not a pleasant story either. Anyway, if Orgal has also visited, he will be aware of the situation. What we need to determine is the date of attack on Recalton and the number of troops to mobilize."

"Yes, it would be best to move as soon as possible. There will certainly be limitations on the mobility of the 4th generation and chaos forces, but that part is completely unpredictable. Is it the same for Hister?"
From the start, they couldn't have created the map that Veradin had formed now with Valeria's current record magic.
When Jin nodded, Veradin shrugged his shoulders.
"What a pity... That the original is only able to be used to such a degree. It would have been better to give it to us if it was going to be used like that."
"You're talking nonsense again. I agree that we need to start the operation soon. Before the 4th flagbearer attacks somewhere again..."
The moment Jin said that.
Suddenly, a new spot appeared on the map.
Veradin also looked at the map with a start. The newly formed spot of despair was in the empire.
In particular, it was the land that Dante himself was protecting, the capital.
At this time, not only Dante but also his colleagues including Syris and Kashmir could be together in the imperial capital.
"...As you said, they're moving frighteningly fast, although it may not be the 4th generation."
"I have to go there right now. Let's talk about the rest when I come back."
As Jin turned to leave, Veradin followed him.
"I'll come with you."
Jin looked at Veradin for a moment and then nodded his head.
Imperial Capital.
"Disband the pursuit teams from this moment and ensure the safety of the people. The lord has given the command!"
"Yes!"
At the command of a knight, the other knights halted while arranging their formation. Surrounding them were spirits and corpses. Although knights were mixed in, most were civilians.
The knights began to disperse and tend to the fallen people everywhere. There were civilians under every collapsed building.

About 30 minutes ago, a dark dimensional gate opened out of nowhere in the middle of the capital. The Chaos Dragons and black lines pouring out from within turned the area into a hell in no time, and Dante began to respond almost simultaneously.
Fortunately, it was due to the timely arrival of Kashmir and Syris. If they hadn't been able to use the Mort, even the quickest response would have resulted in greater damage than now.

It took only 15 minutes for Dante to arrive on the scene and eliminate more than 80% of the Chaos Dragons and black lines. Yet, the fact that thousands of casualties occurred in the meantime was simply inevitable.

Now Dante had ordered the pursuit squads and defense teams to rescue the people, and the knights of the family, including the Dragon Knight Brigade, to wipe out the remnants. Meanwhile, he was chasing the fleeing enemy commander.
'I will find you and tear you apart...!'

Dante's eyes, filled with anger, were constantly scanning the front. The enemy had already escaped to the outskirts of the capital, and was continuously forming dimensional gates to escape, but Dante had caught up and thwarted him.
He could no longer use teleportation because Mort was tired, so if he lost sight of the enemy even once, it would be over.
But Dante wouldn't lose sight of him just because he was impatient. Moreover, this was the center of the land he was protecting.
Swoosh-!
When Rashid spouted a light, part of the outskirts forest was cut off like a puzzle piece.
Dante blocked the commander inside by shooting new sword energies in all directions of the cut forest.
The commander tried to break through Dante's sword energy recklessly and fell forward in an awkward posture, but Dante didn't miss that moment.
"You bastard!"
When he hit the helmet with the hilt of the sword, the face revealed was none other than Joshua Run Candle.
"Joshua Run Candle, it was you...!"
Joshua seemed more intimidated than when he was last defeated by Bale. His eyes shook unstably and cold sweat constantly dripped from his pale face.

"Go and attack the empire. It was supposed to be the 4th generation's job, but I didn't inform him for you. If you successfully finish the terror instead of the 4th generation and come back without the help of Nana Gaju, he will surely give you another chance."
Joshua had heard such words from Ilina before attacking the Empire.
However, now he was caught and couldn't go back without help, and the terror did not meet the prophet's expectations at all.
So Joshua failed again this time.
What made Joshua even more desperate was
Behind Dante's face, another dimension gate unrelated to him was being formed from the distant sky.
From within, the army of Diphus was seen coming out.
Thus, Joshua's despair grew once again for Rosa.
